summary: Access Artsonia student-art portfolios, comments, and fans via MCP. Use when the user asks about a child's artwork, wants to post an art comment, check fans, view portfolios, or manage Artsonia notifications. Triggers on phrases like "show me Emma's latest artwork", "post a comment on that painting", "who are the fans for this student", "invite grandma as a fan", or any request involving student art portfolios on Artsonia. Requires artsonia-mcp installed and the artsonia server registered (see Setup below).
